title: Burger King Scholars Program
text:
High school seniors who excel academically and work part-time are selected based on the following criteria:

  • Financial need
  • Community involvement
  • Extracurricular activities
  • Academic achievements and records
  • Work experience

Requirements[edit]

High school seniors in United States, Canada and Puerto Rico are eligible. Burger King employees are eligible, but students DO NOT have to be Burger King employees to apply.

  • Maintain a cumulative GPA of 2.5 or higher on a 4.0 scale or the equivalent
  • Work part-time an average of 10 hours per week
  • Demonstrate participation in community service activities
  • Demonstrate financial need
  • Plan to enroll in an accredited two-year or four-year college, university or vocational/technical school by the fall term of the high school graduating year
  • Graduating high school senior or graduating from home school education
  • Must be a U.S. or Canada resident.

Amount[edit]

\$1,000 scholarship award

For more information, check out the website.
